card.description:
**Director of Quality & Compliance**
====================================

**Southern Peaks, Canon City CO**

[Full-Time)

$95,000 To $120,000 Annually

DailyPay Available

**Looking for More Than Just a Job?**
-------------------------------------

At Abraxaswe believe every person deserves the opportunity to live a meaningful, fulfilling, and independent life.

We’re seeking compassionate, dedicated professionals who are looking for more than a paycheck. We’re looking for individuals who want to make a difference, build rewarding careers, and become part of a team committed to helping others succeed.

Whether you’re beginning your career, changing professions, or bringing years of experience, we provide the training, support, and opportunities needed to help you thrive.

**About Abraxas**
-----------------

For more than 50 years, Abraxas has been dedicated to improving lives through high-quality services and support.

Our employees play a vital role in helping individuals achieve greater independence, confidence, and success while promoting dignity, respect, inclusion, and personal choice.

Every day, our team members make a meaningful impact by supporting people in reaching their goals and living their best lives.

**Why Join Our Team?**
======================

**Competitive Pay & Benefits**
------------------------------

* Competitive Compensation
* DailyPay – Access Your Earned Wages Before Payday
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance- AFTER 30 DAYS
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Programs
* Employee Referral Bonuses
* Company-Paid Training

**Career Growth & Development**
-------------------------------

* Paid Training Programs
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Certification Opportunities
* Leadership Development Programs
* Career Advancement Opportunities
* Opportunities Across Multiple Service Lines

**Meaningful Work That Matters**
--------------------------------

* Make a Difference Every Day
* Support Individuals and Families
* Build Meaningful Relationships
* Strengthen Communities
* Join a Mission-Driven Organization

**What You’ll Do**
==================

As the Director of Quality & Compliance, you will:

Oversees compliance with applicable Colorado Department of Human Services (CDHS) Volume 7 residential licensing rules, including 12 CCR 2509-8, Section 7.714, as well as payer contracts and Joint Commission standards.

* Reviews and approves corrective action plans for regulatory, payer, and accreditation findings before routing them for final approval. Verifies implementation and sustained compliance.
* Works with Quality and Compliance Specialist and Program Directors to prepare for licensing inspections, Medicaid and managed care reviews, and accreditation surveys.
* Serves as a compliance liaison with CDHS and applicable Regional Accountable Entities (RAEs) and other payers. Reviews provider manuals and contract changes and translates requirements into program procedures.
* Conducts program and follow-up audits, including reviews of admissions, assessments, treatment plans, service documentation, discharge planning, and continuity of care.
* Provides technical assistance to Quality and Compliance Specialists and trains program staff on licensing, payer, and accreditation requirements.
* Develops monitoring tools with Quality and Compliance Specialists to verify compliance and consistent implementation of program policies.
* Analyzes audit findings, incidents, grievances, clinical outcomes, and authorization or denial trends. Reports findings and tracks improvement actions with program leaders.
* Partners with Clinical, Admissions, and Billing to oversee utilization management, including prior authorization, concurrent and continued-stay review, medical necessity and level-of-care documentation, and responses to denials and appeals.
* Develops and reviews policies and procedures, supports the annual review process, and verifies that programs maintain current policy and procedure manuals.
* Participates on various internal and external committees as needed.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Who We’re Looking For**
=========================

You may be a great fit if you are:

✔ Compassionate

✔ Dependable

✔ Patient

✔ Team-Oriented

✔ Service-Focused

✔ Professional

✔ Positive

✔ Committed to Helping Others

**Qualifications**
==================

Master's degree in social sciences, healthcare or related field and five years of quality and compliance experience or bachelor’s degree in social sciences, healthcare or related field and seven years quality and compliance experience

* Ability to effectively supervise employees.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Colorado Volume 7 residential licensing requirements, Health First Colorado behavioral health managed care, and applicable accreditation standards is critical.
* Ability to interpret and teach the application of regulations, payer requirements, accreditation standards, and contractual language.
* Experience with behavioral health utilization management, including authorization, medical necessity and continued-stay documentation, and payer audits. Experience in youth residential mental health or psychiatric residential treatment facilities (PRTFs) is preferred.
* Experience with Prison Rape Elimination Act (PREA) compliance, including staff training, audit preparation, and corrective action follow-up, is preferred.
* Knowledge of adolescent residential mental health treatment, including trauma-informed care, co-occurring conditions, and the needs of youth involved in child welfare or juvenile justice.
* Proven ability to develop and revise policies that meet licensing, payer, contractual, and accreditation requirements.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in written form, with a diverse group of people including regulatory agency representatives, employees, clients, governing body members, and the general public.
* Must be available for travel, to include overnight stays.
* Must have a valid driver’s license.
* Ability to work with computers and the necessary software typically used by the department.

**Physical Requirements (If Applicable)**
=========================================

* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, and assist individuals as needed
* Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation

**Apply Today**
===============

Some jobs pay the bills. Some jobs build careers. This job changes lives.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your compassion, dedication, and hard work make a real difference every day, we encourage you to apply today.

**Join our team and become the reason someone has a better day.**

### **About Our Organization**

**Abraxas** is part of the Inperium family of companies.

Employment for this position is administered through Apis Services, Inc.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

Apis Services, Inc., Inperium Inc., and affiliates provide equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment in compliance with all federal and applicable state and local laws and regulations, including nondiscrimination in hiring and employment.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

This policy of nondiscrimination and equal employment opportunity extends to every phase and aspect of hiring and employment

card.title: Director of Operations - Aiken, SC
card.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

The Director of Operations is responsible for the activities of manufacturing, purchasing, quality, planning (supply chain), and project management of the organization and aids in formulating and administering organization policies.

#LI-SL1

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

* Participating in formulating/administering company policies and developing long range goals/objectives.
* Directing/coordinating activities of the responsible departments on a day-to-day basis to ensure that daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual objectives are met.
* Ensuring internal auditing for compliance with the ISO standards applicable.
* Driving cost reduction (productivity) planning and execution in accordance with the financial plan.
* Providing authorization for funds to ensure responsible fiduciary spending in accordance with financial policies.
* Reviewing/analyzing activities related to costs, operations, CAPEX, and forecast data to determine progress toward financial goals and objectives and considering the long-range impact of growing the business and adjusting actions to ensure compliance.
* Overseeing the budget/forecast processes as well as ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance.
* Conferring with other senior personnel to review achievements and discuss required changes in goals or objectives resulting from current status/conditions.
* Developing plans and executing actions to meet the decision upon actions.
* Providing oversight and coordination to other business in Operations related matters to drive consistency among the businesses.
* Participating in due diligence process as requested.
* Developing succession planning strategies in coordination with HR to ensure continuation of leadership/individual contributor roles going forward.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management, Industrial Engineering, or related field
* Master’s Degree in Business Administration (required)
* 20+ years of relevant operations experience (required)
* 20+ years of experience as a Senior Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or a similar role, preferably in a heavy manufacturing environment with multi-site responsibility
* 10+ years of experience with TPM and SAP
* Welding, Fabricating, Warehouse & Logistics experience
* Operational Excellence or Lean Certification
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing
* Staff development and engagement skills
* Bi-lingual Spanish/English preferred

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

**Hubbell Utility Solutions**

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class.

The above summary of position responsibilities and requirements is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an exhaustive list of duties, skills, efforts, physical requirements, or working conditions associated with the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

card.title: Director of Technical Operations
card.description:
### **Description**

At Pacific Seafood, we do more than just provide the world with the healthiest proteins on the planet. We are a family-owned, excellence-driven organization committed to being the brand of choice in the marketplace and the employer of choice in the community. We believe in servant leadership, investing in our team members’ personal and professional growth, and rewarding performance. We live by the core values of our Diamond Philosophy: Teamwork, Productivity, Quality, and Excellence—which means consistently doing your best and *always* striving to do better.
 
 
**Summary:**

We are seeking a dynamic, solutions-oriented **Director of Technology Operations** to lead, scale, and optimize IT operations for our enterprise. Serving as a strategic partner to leadership and business unit heads across geographies, this role is accountable for the reliability, agility, and continuous evolution of our enterprise technology ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a transformative, hands-on leader who blends deep technical fluency with strong financial stewardship and operational maturity. Rather than introducing rigid bureaucracy, this leader takes a pragmatic, evolutionary approach—fine-tuning existing workflows, aligning IT service delivery with measurable business outcomes, and fostering an empowering, "Best in Class" culture across Service Desk, Project Management Office (PMO), Infrastructure, and Enterprise Applications.

Because our team members are our greatest asset and strength, this role directly assesses the VP’s direct reports and the next level of leaders, identifies strengths and gaps, and ensures each leader has a practical development plan. The Director also evaluates reporting relationships, spans of control, role clarity, and succession depth, and uses a working knowledge of income statements and balance sheets to connect people decisions to business results.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise IT Service Delivery & Service Desk Operations**

* **Support Leadership:** Direct the strategy and daily execution of end-user support, including the IT Service Desk, Desktop Support, Field Services, Depot/Procurement, and VIP/Executive Support across multiple time zones.
* **SLA & Throughput Excellence:** Establish, monitor, and enforce aggressive Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure consistent, predictable service throughput—even during critical end-of-month, end-of-quarter, or high-volume operational periods.
* **End-to-End Lifecycle Management:** Oversee the complete IT lifecycle of internal and customer-facing systems, including enterprise workstations, telephony, infrastructure, and specialized operational/manufacturing hardware.
* **Operational Readiness & Business Continuity:** Lead contingency planning, risk surfacing, and operational readiness initiatives to protect business continuity and minimize disruptions during organizational transitions or major system cutovers.

**2. ITSM, ITIL Frameworks & IT Governance**

* **ITSM & ITIL Maturity:** Own, design, and continuously optimize core ITIL processes—including Incident, Problem, Request, Change, Escalation, and Knowledge Management—within enterprise platforms.
* **IT Intake & Demand Management:** Architect and govern a centralized IT Intake process to evaluate, prioritize, and route incoming business requests, ensuring resource allocation aligns with strategic corporate objectives and operational capacity.
* **Enterprise Governance & Compliance:** Establish pragmatic IT governance models, internal controls, and compliance frameworks that safeguard enterprise data and infrastructure without impeding business agility.
* **Knowledge & Self-Service Enablement:** Drive continuous improvement in knowledge base creation, documentation standards, and automated self-service tools to empower end-users and accelerate first-contact resolution.

**3. Project Management Office (PMO) & Digital Transformation**

* **PMO Leadership & Tollgate Governance:** Develop, deploy, and oversee formalized project management methodologies and tools. Serve as the executive tollgate for technology initiatives to ensure requirements are rigorously defined, scoped, and aligned with strategic goals.
* **Enterprise System Implementations:** Lead cross-functional execution for major digital transformation initiatives, including ERP migrations, CRM rollouts, and M&A technology integrations.
* **AI & Automation Readiness:** Champion the pragmatic adoption of emerging technologies and AI-driven workflows across IT operations to automate routine tasks, enhance reporting accuracy, and elevate enterprise productivity.

**4. Continuous Improvement & Lean Operations**

* **Lean Six Sigma Execution:** Embed Lean and Continuous Improvement methodologies into daily IT operations to eliminate waste, reduce turnaround times, and streamline cross-departmental workflows.
* **Root Cause & Corrective Action:** Partner closely with all IT Operations teams on deep failure-mode analysis and root-cause corrective actions to permanently resolve recurring technical issues and business impacts.
* **Asset & Inventory Optimization:** Reframe IT hardware, spare parts, and demo/recon pools as actively managed operational assets—optimizing space utilization, procurement costing, redistribution, and lifecycle disposition.

**5. Customer Satisfaction & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* **Customer-Centric Culture:** Champion an unwavering focus on internal and external customer satisfaction, transforming IT from a transactional support function into a proactive, trusted business enabler.
* **Executive & Departmental Alignment:** Foster transparent, collaborative partnerships with Finance, Manufacturing, Distribution, Quality, Engineering, and Sales leadership to ensure technology roadmaps directly support revenue and operational goals.
* **Voice of the Customer:** Implement regular satisfaction tracking, feedback loops, and executive business reviews to measure stakeholder sentiment and drive targeted service enhancements.

**6. Financial Stewardship & Resource Optimization**

* **Multi-Million-Dollar P&L Management:** Develop, justify, and manage a $15M–$30M+ IT operations budget, maintaining strict fiscal discipline across OPEX, CAPEX, vendor contracts, and software licensing.
* **Data-Driven Economics:** Apply rigorous cost-benefit and repair-versus-replace analyses to hardware maintenance, vendor agreements, and service models, identifying opportunities to reduce operational costs while improving service quality.
* **Vendor & Outsourced Partner Management:** Negotiate and manage contracts with third-party vendors, hardware suppliers, and managed service providers to ensure accountability and maximum return on investment.

**7. Talent Development & Organizational Leadership**

* **Inspirational People Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and coach a diverse, geographically dispersed organization of managers, engineers, analysts, and technicians.
* **Cross-Training & Team Resilience:** Eliminate single-point dependencies by building structured cross-training programs, clear career pathways, and flexible skill coverage across teams.
* **High-Accountability & Morale:** Cultivate a high-morale, low-turnover environment rooted in psychological safety, diversity, equity, and inclusion, while holding staff to clear performance standards through active coaching and accountability.

 

### **What you bring to Pacific Seafood**

**Required:**

* **Executive or Senior Leadership Track Record:** 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in IT Operations, Service Delivery, or Technical Operations, including 5+ years at the Director or Senior level within a complex, multi-site, or enterprise environment.
* **Proven Operational Impact:** Demonstrated history of scaling support teams, managing multi-million-dollar budgets, and delivering measurable reductions in operational costs and ticket turnaround times.
* **Enterprise Transformation:** Hands-on experience leading large-scale ERP/CRM transitions, ITIL/ITSM framework implementations, and post-M&A systems integration.
* **Cross-Industry Fluency:** Strong operational understanding of corporate IT alongside manufacturing, distribution, engineering, or field-service environments.

**Education & Certifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related technical discipline. Preferred; advanced degrees, e.g., Master of Business Administration (MBA)

**Certifications, not required, but highly desired:**

* ITIL Certification
* Lean Six Sigma Certification
* Project Management Professional or active PMI affiliation strongly preferred.

**Physical Requirements** 
 
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a team member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the team member:

* Must be available to work Monday -Friday during regular working hours, with occasional weekend duties.
* Ability to maintain a stationary position 80% of the time, with intermittent walking, standing, bending, reaching, and/or crawling.
* Ability to move and transport documents, equipment, or other items weighing up to 50 pounds across various locations for different team members, departments, and events.
* Capable of occasional travel as required by duties, demonstrating efficiency and effectiveness in diverse locations.
* Capable of operating a computer and other office productivity machinery, including a calculator, copy machine, and printer.
* Capable of frequently communicating with team members and stakeholders, accurately conveying detailed or important spoken instructions.
* Capable of perceiving visuals for activities such as preparing and analyzing data and figures, transcribing, viewing a computer screen, and engaging in extensive reading.

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job.*

**Working Conditions** 
The working environment characteristics described here are representative of those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the team member is exposed to:

* Traditional office environment
* Standard office equipment (computers, printers, phones, etc.)
* Well-illuminated environment

card.description:
**General Summary:**

Oversees and gives direction to company production operations, including assembly, test, and integration departments. Develops and implements programs to ensure that finished products meet all engineering specifications and quality standards. Establishes standards and measurement systems to monitor production performance. Monitors the loading and execution of production assembly and test departments to meet company schedule and revenue requirements. Directs the transition of new products from engineering to production, working with test engineering to achieve effective test solutions. Reviews and approves the testing and evaluation methods of standard and special devices, monitoring and ensuring the conformance to all Astronics quality processes and procedures.

 

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Manages production teams engaged in electronic or electro-mechanical assembly of precision components, subassemblies and finished products.
* Develops new or improved manufacturing processes and conducts manufacturing feasibility studies for proposed new product designs.
* Ensures the efficient flow of products through all phases of production.
* Collaborates with the finance organization in assuring the proper cost accounting procedures for production operations.
* Prepares and presents status reviews to Operations management on key production objectives such as reduction in defective assemblies and on-time delivery.
* Acts as liaison with the production planning organization regarding prioritization of production schedules and product delivery commitments.
* Supports the transition of new products from engineering to production, working with test engineering to achieve effective test solutions.
* Coordinates with the procurement organization to ensure that specialized parts, components, and materials acquired through subcontractors conform to technical specifications, quality standards and master project schedules.
* Performance management of direct reports. Develops and manages employee development goals and related training opportunities. Completes annual performance reviews of direct reports and recommends appropriate merit increases.
* Works with the customer service department to assure shared resources are allocated appropriately to meet all schedule demands.
* Performs corrective action investigations for both ICARS and CARS that have been issued to the production floor.
* May serve on cross-functional teams to address key operational issues.
* Responsible for ensuring all laws, regulations, and other applicable obligations are observed wherever and whenever business is conducted on behalf of the Company.
* Responsible for ensuring work is accomplished in a safe manner in accordance with established operating procedures and practices.

 

**Job Qualifications:**

* Typically requires a bachelor's degree in business administration or a related field as well as 8–15+ years in manufacturing operations, with demonstrated P&L ownership and management responsibilities. Equivalent professional experience may be substituted in lieu of education. Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, MBA, or equivalent is a plus.
* Demonstrates expertise in the application of operational principles, concepts, theory, and practice as well as project management and leadership skills including organization, planning, scheduling, and coordinating workloads to meet established deadlines and delivery schedules.
* Must possess the ability to resolve complex operational and production problems.
* Strong communication, leadership, presentation, and interpersonal skills are required to enable an effective interface with other departments, all levels of management, professional and support staff, customers, potential customers.
* Customer focused, must be able to work on a self-initiated basis and in a team environment, and able to work extended hours and travel as needed.

 

**Compensation:**

For individuals hired to work in California, Astronics Test Systems (ATS) is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This compensation range is specific to California. Any offer extended to a candidate will be based upon their unique set of knowledge, skills, education, and experience, as well as internal equity. A reasonable estimate of the range for this position is $145,000 - $160,000 annually.

 

**Employment Eligibility Requirements:**

* An offer of employment is contingent on successfully passing a drug test and background check
* This position may involve access to items subject to U.S. export-control laws. Employment is contingent upon the employee's authorization to access such items under applicable law. The company does not guarantee and is under no obligation to seek such authorization if it would be necessary.

 

**Astronics Test Systems offers a competitive benefit package including:**

* **Stay Healthy**- Health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, FSA, HSA, as well as voluntary life/AD&D, voluntary critical illness, accident prevention and hospital indemnity
* **Save for the Future** - 401K & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* **Find Balance**- Employee Assistance Program & Wellness Program
* **Time for You**- Generous Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays and Paid Parental Leave
* **Professional Growth**- Tuition Reimbursement Program

**Accommodation Request:**

Astronics Test Systems is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you need special assistance or an accommodation while seeking employment, please e-mail ats-ml-humanresources@astronics.com or call: 407.381.6062. We will make a determination regarding your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.

Astronics Corporation (Nasdaq: ATRO) serves the world's aerospace, defense, and other mission critical industries with proven, innovative technology solutions. Astronics works side-by-side with customers, integrating its array of power, connectivity, lighting, structures, interiors, and test technologies to solve complex challenges. For over 50 years, Astronics has delivered creative, customer-focused solutions with exceptional responsiveness. Today, global airframe manufacturers, airlines, militaries, completion centers and Fortune 500 companies rely on the collaborative spirit and innovation of Astronics. The Company's strategy is to increase its value by developing technologies and capabilities that provide innovative solutions to its targeted markets. 
 
For more information on Astronics and its solutions, visit www.Astronics.com.

**Why Build Your Career with Prysmian?**

**Your work at Prysmian helps power and connect the world.**

Prysmian, the world leader in solutions for energy and digital connections, strengthen its global team with the 2025 addition of Channell, now part of Prysmian. Founded by the Channell family in 1922, Channell brings a long‑standing legacy of innovation in outside plant infrastructure, serving Telecommunications, Municipalities, Internet Service Providers, Wireless, Water, Power, and CATV markets. Together, Prysmian and Channell team members are combining expertise, craftsmanship, and shared values to deliver a broader portfolio, from advanced cable systems and fiber connectivity solutions to enclosures and below‑grade vaults which support resilient infrastructure, the energy transition, and the growth of digital networks around the world.

When you join Prysmian, you become part of a global team whose work touches millions of lives every day. You’ll help support the energy and digital infrastructure that keeps communities, businesses, and industries moving forward.

For more than 140 years, Prysmian has helped shape the infrastructure that powers progress. From helping illuminate the Statue of Liberty in 1886 and delivering power from Hoover Dam to Los Angeles in 1935, to supporting New York City's rebuilding efforts after September 11, our cables and connectivity solutions have played a role in some of history's most significant milestones.

**What You’ll Bring:**

**Experience and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations management, business administration, or related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing operations leadership experience, including 5+ years leading multiple sites or a multi-plant network.
* Proven track record managing P&L, capital budgets, and operational KPIs across geographically dispersed facilities.
* Deep knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or comparable continuous improvement methodologies; certification (Lean/Six Sigma Green or Black Belt) preferred.
* Strong experience with ERP/MES systems and data-driven decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through others, build high-performing teams, and manage change across a diverse, multi-site organization.
* Working knowledge of OSHA, environmental regulations, and quality systems (ISO 9001 or equivalent).
* Experience in electronics, cable/connector, or precision component manufacturing a plus.
* Familiarity with thermoplastic molding - low and high pressure injection molding, rotational molding, and blow molding
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly (up to 40–50%) between facilities, including international travel as applicable.
* Executive-level communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership and the board.
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost analysis.
* Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills in a fast-paced, multi-site manufacturing environment.

**What You'll Do:**

The Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership across the company's multi-site manufacturing network. This role is accountable for driving safety, quality, productivity, cost, and delivery performance at every facility while building a consistent operating system, talent pipeline, and culture of continuous improvement across locations.

card.title: Senior Manager of Lab Operations & Fermentati
card.description:
**Purpose:**

The Senior Manager of Lab Operations & Fermentation Development is responsible for leading efficient, safe, and compliant laboratory operations that ensure accurate testing, support fermentation and manufacturing processes, maintain product quality, and drive continuous improvement through reliable data, standardized procedures, and effective resource management.

**Role Accountabilities:**

* Balance quality, productivity, and safety to achieve results to continuously improve in all areas
* Leads the microbiological support and preparations to assist fermentation process in the microbial lab ensuring performance of microbiological media preparations
* Become proficient with testing in the analytical lab (i.e. protein, fat, fibers, HPLC, HPIC, ICP, and GC)
* Maintain adequate laboratory testing supplies within budget
* Assist with assuring all consumable materials inventory is adequate to operate the laboratory in an efficient manner, while staying on budget
* Maintains automated and digitized record keeping and proper documentation for all laboratory testing and analysis
* Conduct finished product quality control analysis including microbial streak plating, serial dilution and spread plating for cell counts, light microscopy, enzyme testing, etc.
* General laboratory maintenance and organization related to cleaning glassware and workspace sanitation, including keeping workspace free from clutter at all times
* Lead proficiency with testing in the analytical lab (i.e. protein, fat, fibers, HPLC, HPIC, ICP, and GC)
* Become proficient with data analysis and data entry into Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS)
* Ensures timely completion and accuracy of all COA’s
* Ensure leadership and documentation in all sampling & testing efforts
* Maintain and ensure full operation of analytical lab and equipment: calibration and validation of data, organization of data (LIMS), HPLC (US-VIS, RID, MS), GC-FID, Leco, Ankom fat and fiber, UV-VIS, ICP, off-gas analyzer, water analysis equipment)
* Perform or assist in ensuring real time monitoring techniques (DO, pH, off-gas, temp, etc.) for successful fermentation and blending manufacturing
* Ensure there is data in a structured system and then ensuring its visibility to the CEO through an online report that updates monthly
* Working non-standard hours to support fermentation monitoring
* Lead the creation and follow through on all standard operating procedures as well as requirements set by SFSF, NASC, SGF and FAMI-QS
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Microbiology, Biochemistry, or a related field
* 5+ years of experience in laboratory operations, analytical testing, microbiology, or fermentation processes, with leadership experience preferred
* Strong knowledge of microbiological testing, sample preparation, and quality control procedures
* Experience with analytical laboratory equipment, including HPLC, GC, ICP, UV-VIS, and protein, fat, and fiber analysis
* Ability to manage laboratory budgets, inventory, supplies, and resources effectively
* Ability to work flexible or non-standard hours to support fermentation monitoring and manufacturing operations
* Familiarity with SFSF, NASC, SGF, and FAMI-QS standards is preferred

**Required Skills:**

* Strong leadership, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills
* Experience with equipment calibration, validation, troubleshooting, and laboratory maintenance
* Demonstrated ability to develop, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and ensure regulatory compliance
* Proficient in aseptic techniques, environmental monitoring programs (EMP), microorganism culturing and the maintenance and propagation of organism libraries
* Familiarity with LIMS, HPLC, LC-MS, and other analytical methods such as ash, fiber and fat analysis is a plus
* Strong understanding of laboratory safety regulations and quality management systems
* Commitment to workplace safety, quality assurance, continuous improvement, and accurate reporting
